meta.title: Nextocode — Specialized software and services for your business
meta.description: Nextocode builds specialized software, like Negocenda, and delivers implementation, support and custom development for companies that want to grow with technology.

hero.subtitle: We build tailored software for real-world operations and stay with you at every step — from rollout to everyday support.

statement.body: We deliver operations that work. Every Nextocode product is born from concrete, day-to-day problems and is looked after by a team that knows your business by name.

products.title: Negocenda. Your entire operation in one place.
products.subtitle: Sales, inventory, online store and customer service connected in one platform built for retail and hospitality.

management.title: Real-time management
management.text: Sales, margins and inventory across every location in one clear dashboard, updated with each transaction.

pos.title: Fast point of sale
pos.text: Quick, intuitive checkout with multiple payment methods and a register that always reconciles.

inventory.title: Smart inventory
inventory.text: Track stock in and out, with automatic alerts before a product runs out.

ecommerce.title: Integrated online store
ecommerce.text: Your catalog, prices and stock synced automatically with your online shop.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.text: Ask about your business in plain language and get answers and reports instantly.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp service
whatsapp.text: Orders, confirmations and notifications on the channel your customers already use every day.

mock.aiQuestion: What was our best-selling product this week?
mock.aiAnswer: Specialty coffee 250 g: 312 units, up 18% from last week.

services.title: Software is the beginning. Partnership makes the difference.
services.subtitle: A dedicated team alongside your company at every stage.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.text: We configure, migrate your data and get everything running without disrupting your operation.

support.title: Expert support
support.text: Fast, human support from people who know the product — and your business — inside out.

custom.title: Custom development
custom.text: Dedicated features and modules when your process calls for something unique.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.text: We connect payments, invoicing and the systems you already rely on.

training.title: Training
training.text: Hands-on training so everyone on your team gets the most out of the platform from day one.

consulting.title: Technology consulting
consulting.text: We analyze your processes and design the solution that best supports your growth.

approach.title: Simple on the outside. Rigorous on the inside.

discover.title: Understand
discover.text: We listen to your operation and pinpoint what truly matters.

design.title: Design
design.text: We define the solution, timelines and expected outcomes with full transparency.

build.title: Deploy
build.text: We go live with testing, migrated data and a trained team.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.text: We monitor, measure and keep improving — together with you.

focus.title: Specialization
focus.text: We build for industries we know deeply, not for everyone at once.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: Cloud infrastructure, security and continuous updates, so you never have to worry.

closeness.title: Closeness
closeness.text: You talk to people, not tickets. We're there when you need us.

contact.title: Let's build your business's next step.
contact.subtitle: Tell us what you need. We reply within one business day.

footer.tagline: Specialized software and services for companies that move forward.
